title: ちょうちょう (Chouchou — Butterfly)
description: One of Japan's oldest surviving school songs, published in 1881 in the first Ministry of Education songbook. Set to the melody of the German folk song 'Hänschen klein,' it describes a butterfly flitting from rapeseed leaves to cherry blossoms, playing freely from flower to flower. A second verse describes a sparrow. Simple and joyful, it has been sung by Japanese children for over 140 years.
license: Public Domain (Lyrics adapted from German folk melody 'Hänschen klein'; Japanese version published 1881 in 小学唱歌集 — copyright expired)
